headline: Executive order directs federal attention to price fixing and anti-competitive behavior in the food supply chain, framing it as a security risk.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order addresses price fixing and other anti-competitive behavior in the food supply chain and treats these practices as a security concern. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies involved, and deadlines are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.how: Companies in the food supply chain may face closer federal review of pricing and competition practices.
The order's stated focus is on practices that can affect food prices, though its direct effect on consumers is not described in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 6, 2025; specific effective dates for any actions are not stated in the available information.
